info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices API provides a comprehensive list of devices associated with active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about devices that have subscribed to streaming services, facilitating better management and oversight. Typical users include developers integrating streaming functionality into applications, as well as system administrators monitoring device usage. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer engagement and ensure optimal resource allocation across their streaming platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices under the subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all devices that are associated with the given subscriptions. Use this to view the current devices and their statuses.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the list of devices associated with a subscription. This request should include the necessary parameters to filter or specify the subscription details for the devices queried.

201.description: The request was successful, and a new resource has been created.
